title: Duodenal biopsy – narrative canned report v6

microscopy_text.description: Write ONE short paragraph in UK histopathology style (not a list, not copied input). DO NOT repeat the user’s words verbatim. Start with 'The sections show duodenal mucosa'. Then describe villous architecture and IELs in a full sentence: e.g. '...with retained villous architecture and no increase in intraepithelial lymphocytes.' If villous blunting/atrophy is present, say '...with villous blunting.' If IELs are increased, say 'Intraepithelial lymphocytes are increased.' Only mention chronic inflammation/duodenitis if explicitly stated in the input. Do not use phrases like 'may suggest' or 'warrants'. Always end with exactly: 'There is no dysplasia or malignancy.'
